claims.claim: Faulty inverter AC available for sale.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an AC unit but does not show it running, any error code, or any inverter-specific label clearly.

risks.risk: Whether it is truly an inverter AC (inverter vs non-inverter affects parts and value).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the rating plate/label showing 'Inverter' (or model number) and the full brand/model text.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-inverter faulty AC.

risks.risk: Fault type is unknown (compressor, fan motor, PCB, gas leak, capacitor, etc.).
risks.proof: Video of power-on with the unit connected (showing any lights, error codes, and whether compressor/fan starts), plus a technician test report if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / needs major repair.

risks.risk: Capacity (e.g., 7000) is only partially readable; wrong capacity changes market price.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the full capacity marking on the label (e.g., '7000' and unit type) or the model number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest likely capacity shown/assumed from the partial marking.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (remote control, mounting kit, filters, or damaged fins) can reduce usability.
risks.proof: Photos of included items: remote (if any), power cord condition, and close-ups of front/back fins for bends or leaks.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the rating plate showing brand, full model number, and whether it is 'Inverter'.
Send a short video of the AC being powered on (show lights/error codes and whether compressor and indoor/outdoor fans run).
Send close-up photos of the power cord/plug and the front & side fins (check for bends/leaks).
Confirm what exactly is faulty (e.g., not cooling, not starting, trips breaker) in one message.
response.reason: The photo shows an AC unit but does not prove inverter status, capacity details, or the specific fault. Without a power-on/error/fault description, the worst-case repair cost is unknown, so a reliable price cannot be set yet.
